response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, leadership in AI-agent infrastructure, and exposure to MCP and cloud platforms, but lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, direct experience with vector databases/RAG, and formal AI/ML domain expertise, which are core to the role.
strengths: Demonstrated leadership in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Extensive experience with cloud platforms (AWS), TypeScript, and scalable data systems
Proven track record of mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions in engineering excellence
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years focused on production-grade AI/ML systems
Missing explicit experience with vector databases or RAG architectures
Limited documentation of LLM optimization, multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI), or AI evaluation pipelines
